title: Local Anticoncentration for Gaussian Boson Sampling via Conditional Wishart Geometry
summary: Local anticoncentration controls the conversion of additive output probability estimates to relative estimates in Gaussian boson sampling. We prove a center-uniform quadratic small-ball bound for hafnians of complex Gaussian transpose Gram matrices for $2n$ selected modes, with an explicit finite coefficient that is polynomial when the number of Gaussian rows is at least of order $n^2/\log n$. Letting the Gaussian row count tend to infinity yields anticoncentration for the independent complex symmetric Gaussian ensemble.
